answer: On the island, every identity must forge one atlas anchor, and the k-th anchor costs the k-th hexagonal number of forge tokens: the first pays 1, the second 6, the third 15, the tenth 190, so ten identities pay 715. Each anchor also needs a distinct island ore vein, and veins run out: the hundredth fake must sail to a new island and wait a full tide cycle per earlier anchor.
